data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.9m (2014: GBP 8.3m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 5.8m (around 4.3% of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable reserve development in older underwriting years (notably 2011 and 2012), partially offset by adverse development on 2013. The managing agent reports a net favourable reassessment of prior accident years of GBP 3.9m; the difference between the net figure reported and the gross triangle-derived result reflects reinsurer recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: a surplus of GBP 3.9m (2014: GBP 8.3m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development gross figure was not stated explicitly as a single gross 'movement in prior years' note. Gross PYD was calculated from the published gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing current estimates to the prior diagonal for underwriting years <= 2013. The report also states a net favourable reassessment of GBP 3.9m (net of reinsurance); the triangle-derived gross release (-GBP 5.8m) differs from the reported net GBP 3.9m due to reinsurance recoveries. Lob_movements are year-end gross provision changes between 2014 and 2015 and therefore include current-year activity as well as reserve re-estimates; they are provided as indicative movements with moderate confidence.
